description: This file defines the interface ComplexObsHandler for handling complex observations in the OpenMRS system. It includes method signatures for saving, retrieving, purging, and querying supported views for complex Obs data.

classes.name: ComplexObsHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling complex observation data (ComplexData) associated with Obs objects, including methods for saving, fetching, purging data, and querying supported views.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves a complex observation by extracting its ComplexData and storing it, then returns the Obs with its ComplexData nullified.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Fetches and attaches ComplexData to an Obs object based on the specified view type.

methods.name: purgeComplexData
methods.description: Removes the ComplexData associated with a given Obs from storage.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns an array of supported view types for the handler.

methods.name: supportsView
methods.description: Checks if a given view type is supported by the handler.
